item.title: Ninajirachi Dominates 2026 AIR Awards Nominations
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news. Today, we're talking about the upcoming AIR Awards, and one artist who's making waves in the electronic music scene: Ninajirachi.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: Ninajirachi, whose real name is Nina Wilson, has been flying high since the release of her debut album "I Love My Computer" last year. She's already won several awards, including three ARIA Awards, the Australian Music Prize, and the NSW Music Prize for breakthrough artist. And if that's not enough, she's also performed at Coachella 2026 and has a North American tour coming up.
[Music transitions to a slightly more upbeat tone]
Host: Now, Ninajirachi is shortlisted in 10 categories at the AIR Awards, including independent album and single of the year. Her label, NLV Records, is also up for independent label of the year. Other nominees include Teen Jesus And The Jean Teasers, Spacey Jane, and Stella Donnelly.
[Music transitions back to a softer tone]
Host: The AIR Awards will be held on July 30th at the Adelaide Town Hall, and it's an invite-only industry event. The awards recognize, promote, and celebrate the success of Australia's independent music sector. This year, the awards have introduced new categories, including best independent dance/club single and best independent electronic single.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for today. The full list of AIR Awards nominations is available online. We'll be keeping an eye on the awards and bringing you updates on the winners. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
